description:
Bind a legacy-compatible TEE nonce to a verification session

Binds one immutable legacy TEE nonce context to a pending session. Requires an OrgToken and an EIP-191 signature from the organization's registered verification key. Repeating the exact binding is idempotent; conflicting or terminal sessions return 409.

body.description: One immutable legacy TEE context, signed by the organization verification key. The signature is EIP-191 `personal_sign` over `RECLAIM_BUILDER_TEE_BINDING_V1:{organizationId}:{sessionId}:{applicationId}:{timestamp}:{attestationVersion}:{attestationNonce}`.

attestationNonce.description: Either the current lowercase 64-hex hash nonce (without `0x`) or the older 65-byte EIP-191 signature nonce (`0x` plus 130 hex characters). Builder preserves either encoding unchanged.

attestationNonceData.description: Exact legacy TEE nonce inputs. Builder stores this unchanged in the session context after it verifies the signed binding request.

applicationId.description: Ethereum application address derived from the organization private key. Its supplied casing is preserved for legacy nonce compatibility.

attestationVersion.description: Legacy SDK TEE attestation protocol version.

sessionId.description: Verification session id (UUID v7 when supported). Also echoed in the result payload as `reclaimSessionId`.

signature.description: EIP-191 65-byte secp256k1 signature, encoded as 0x-prefixed hex.

orgToken.description: The organization API key (`rorg_…`) this call authenticates with: from `issue_org_token`, or the app's RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET. Defaults to the MCP server's RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET. Never echo it back to the user.

sessionId.description: Verification session id (UUID v7 when supported). Also echoed in the result payload as `reclaimSessionId`.

name: bind_verification_session_tee_nonce
